_docs._about: All user-facing bot messages in one place. Edit the strings here — no JavaScript knowledge needed.
_docs._templates: Messages that contain {placeholder} tokens are dynamic. The placeholder is replaced at runtime by messages.js. Example: 'Hello {user}!' with user='@Alice' → 'Hello @Alice!'

_sections.TICKET_PANEL_*: Strings used to build the ticket category selection embed and dropdown.
_sections.TICKET_WELCOME: First message posted inside a newly opened ticket channel.
_sections.TICKET_*: All other ticket system feedback messages.
_sections.BAN / KICK / MUTE / …: DM titles & bodies sent to the punished user, plus log embed titles and staff-facing success messages.
_sections.APPLICATION_PANEL_*: Strings for the application selection embed.
_sections.APPLICATION_CONFIRM_*: Confirmation DM sent before questions begin.
_sections.PROMOTE / DEMOTE: Promotion log embeds and staff reply text.
_sections.GENERIC_*: Fallback error messages used when no specific message fits.

TICKET_PANEL_DESCRIPTION:
Select a category below to open a support ticket.
Pick the one that best fits your issue.
TICKET_WELCOME:
Hey {user}! Staff will be with you shortly.

Describe your issue and include as much detail as you can.

*Ticket ID: #{ticketId}*
TICKET_BANNED: You're not allowed to open tickets.
TICKET_NOT_BANNED: That user doesn't have a ticket ban.
TICKET_ADD_SUCCESS: {user} has been added to this ticket.
TICKET_REMOVE_SUCCESS: {user} has been removed from this ticket.
TICKET_CLOSE_REQUEST_BODY: A staff member has requested to close this ticket. Confirm below if you're okay with that.
TICKET_TRANSCRIPT_DM_BODY: Your ticket in **{guildName}** has been closed. A transcript is attached below.
UNMUTE_DM_BODY: Your mute in **{guildName}** has been lifted.
INVALID_MUTE_DURATION: Invalid duration. Use formats like `10m`, `1h`, or `7d` (max 28 days).
NO_PERMISSION_BAN: You don't have permission to ban members.
NO_PERMISSION_KICK: You don't have permission to kick members.
NO_PERMISSION_MUTE: You don't have permission to mute members.
NO_PERMISSION_MANAGE: You don't have permission to use this command.
NO_PERMISSION_STAFF: This command is for staff only.
NO_PERMISSION_HIGHER_ROLE: You can't take action on someone with a higher or equal role.
BOT_NO_PERMISSION: I don't have permission to do that.
APPLICATION_PANEL_DESCRIPTION:
**Open positions:**
- Trainee
- Builder
- Developer
- Media
- Beta Tester

Have questions? Open a support ticket.
APPLICATION_PANEL_FOOTER: Pick a role to start your application.
APPLICATION_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an application in progress. Finish or cancel it before starting a new one.
APPLICATION_DM_BLOCKED: I couldn't send you a DM. Make sure your DMs are open and try again.
APPLICATION_STARTED_BODY: Check your DMs to continue your application.
APPLICATION_CONFIRM_BODY:
You're about to apply for **{category}**.

I'll send you a series of questions — you have **{hours} hours** to complete them. You can cancel at any time.
APPLICATION_CONFIRM_BUILDER_NOTE: > **Note:** The Builder role is fully voluntary. Builders have no extra permissions and the work is unpaid.
APPLICATION_CONFIRM_DEV_NOTE: > **Note:** The Developer role is fully voluntary. All submissions require full source code and the work is unpaid.
APPLICATION_IN_PROGRESS_BODY: You have **{hours} hours** to complete this application. Hit cancel at any time to stop.
APPLICATION_SUMMARY_BODY: Review your answers below. Edit anything before submitting.
APPLICATION_SUMMARY_FOOTER: Take your time — you can edit any answer before submitting.
APPLICATION_UPDATED_FALLBACK: Couldn't update the summary. Here's your updated application:
APPLICATION_SUBMITTED_BODY: We've got your application. Staff will review it and get back to you.
APPLICATION_TIMEOUT_BODY: Your application timed out after {hours} hours. Feel free to start a new one whenever you're ready.
APPLICATION_ACCEPTED_REASON_BODY:
Your **{category}** application was accepted!

**Note from staff:** {reason}
APPLICATION_DENIED_BODY: Your **{category}** application wasn't accepted this time.
APPLICATION_DENIED_REASON_BODY:
Your **{category}** application wasn't accepted this time.

**Reason:** {reason}
APPLICATION_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Please start a new application.
APPLICATION_INVALID_QUESTION: That's not a valid question number. Enter a number between 1 and {max}.
APPLICATION_NO_MANAGEMENT: You don't have permission to review applications.
REPORT_BANNED: You're not allowed to submit reports.
REPORT_NO_STAFF: You need a staff role to handle reports.
GENERIC_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
GENERIC_DB_ERROR: A database error occurred. Please try again.
